L6·N5045unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially always negative and is most strongly suppressed by ordinary mid-sentence continuation tokens (contractions/function words like " by", "'s", "'re", proper-noun continuations); it comes closest to zero at segment-boundary or "odd" tokens — newlines, quote marks, stray mangled unicode, and awkward substituted words in machine-spun/translated text.
